title: A distinct voice for a film's checks
statement: Whether a film's in-video checks should be asked in a voice distinct from the one that narrates it, or in that same voice, is disputed.
detail: A direction logged on 6 October asked that students be tested throughout the film by a pop-up guide with a voice different from the narration's (`g9/library/text/L346c3d.txt`, line 22). A later version, following the brief, had the guide read the film and ask the checks in one voice (`g9/library/text/L30b6dc.txt`, line 11). The project's write-up on film, checks and production marked the distinct checking voice as disputed (`g9/library/TIMELINE.md`, line 84).
